messages:
Maria Gomez: opened a slim PR to rework Troubleshooting -> Error reference for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallout. Found a few broken anchors and an example that incorrectly encourages parsing partial JSON from streams. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123
Sam Patel: on it. I'll take the markdown anchor fixes and run lint. Which SDK snippet do we prefer for the resume example? v2 handler?
Alex Rivera: v2 please. People copy-paste that. I'll prepare a compact snippet showing detection of 429 during a stream and options: resume (if resumable/idempotent) or fallback (trim + retry).
Cheng Li: for repro, suggest a `nc`-based curl test to cut the socket mid-stream so we reliably hit the server-side 429 after partial output. Paste below.
Cheng Li: ```bash
# simulate open stream then kill client socket to produce a partial stream + delayed 429
printf '{"model":"rwd-light-1","input":"LONG_PROMPT..."}' | nc api.redwood.ai 443
# kill nc after a few chunks to mimic disconnect
```
Lina Torres: I'll add a tiny Python v2 snippet demonstrating `retry_policy` + trim-to-tail helper and exponential backoff. Will call out `resume_token` semantics explicitly.
Lina Torres: ```python
# pseudo v2 example
resp = client.responses.stream(model="rwd-light-1", input=trim_tail(prompt, 2048))
try:
  for chunk in resp:
    process(chunk)
except StreamError as e:
  if getattr(e, "status_code", None) == 429:
    # if idempotent + have resume token -> attempt rejoin
    # else: apply backoff, trim prompt, or switch to a smaller model
    backoff_and_retry(trim_to_tail(prompt, 1024))
```
Maria Gomez: please add a short decision matrix in the doc: columns = "Resume?", "When safe", "Example action". Keep it tiny. Also add a note under Context limits about looking for `truncated`/`partial` flags in response metadata instead of assuming full fidelity.
Sam Patel: fixed anchors in samples/errref/stream-recovery.md and updated markdownlint errors. CI flagged one stale link to /sdk/v1; updated to /sdk/v2. Re-running CI.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123 — CI queued
Alex Rivera: added a brief paragraph recommending prefix-caching where appropriate to reduce token churn on retries. Also added a pointer to Optimize for quantization suggestion (light touch).
Cheng Li: ran the nc+cURL repro in staging, reproduced stream -> 429 consistently. Added a short note: prefer checking numeric status_code over parsing chunks since partial chunks may be trunc-delimited.
Lina Torres: pushed the SDK snippet and trimmed example to the branch. Left a TODO to reference the SDK config option `retry_policy.max_retries` and `backoff.strategy` with example values.
Sam Patel: CI passed :white_check_mark:. All link checks green.
Maria Gomez: great — can someone add a one-line entry in release-notes.md: "Docs: clarified streaming 429 behavior; added resume vs fallback guidance and updated SDK v2 snippets"?
Alex Rivera: added changelog line and merged after squash.
Maria Gomez: thanks all, closing this thread.
